notes: Final amendment (Amendment No. 2) reporting results; the press release (seq 2) covers four Eaton Vance funds (EVG, EFT, EFR, EVF) but this filing's subject is EFT only, so only EFT's row is extracted. EFT was undersubscribed: the pro-ration factor column reads 'N/A' and the release says EFT will purchase all shares properly tendered, so proration_factor_pct is null (not stated as a number). commencement_date is taken from the Offer to Purchase date (June 29, 2021, also the Schedule TO filing date). Conditions are only referenced, not listed, so conditions is null. trigger_origin: the exhibit index lists '(d)(i) Standstill Agreement dated May 12, 2021', which may indicate an activist settlement, but the filing does not state the reason for the tender, so it is left null. The signature block misnames the filer 'Eaton Vance Floating-Rate Income Fund'.
